description: Spectrogram display — it draws the incoming sound as frequency against time, and sends out the energy in a box drawn across that picture

params.text: Analyses the sound in blocks of 512 samples, which follows changes closely and tells frequencies apart the least well
Analyses the sound in blocks of 1024 samples
Analyses the sound in blocks of 2048 samples, which tells frequencies apart the best and follows changes the most slowly

outputs.text: The average energy inside the box drawn on the display, 0V to 10V, so a part of the spectrum becomes a control voltage

notes: the output rests at 0V until a box is drawn on the display; drag across the display to draw one, and the energy inside it is what the jack sends
the signal is analysed only and is not passed through, so it has to reach the rest of the patch by another route
